content.table_summary: Risk factors and associated history/findings suggestive of pre-existing chronic thromboembolic disease or CTEPH
risk_factors_table: CTPA findings suggestive of pre-existing chronic thromboembolic disease
Thrombophilic disorders, particularly antiphospholipid antibody syndrome and high coagulation factor VIII levels
content.abbreviations: CTEPH = Chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension; CTPA = computed tomographic pulmonary angiography; DVT = deep vein thrombosis; i.v. = intravenous; LV = left ventricular; PE = pulmonary embolism; PH = pulmonary hypertension; RV = right ventricular.

diagnostic_notes.RV_dysfunction_definition: On CTPA (four-chamber views of the heart), RV dysfunction is defined as RV/LV diameter ratio >1.0.
diagnostic_notes.clinical_difficulty: Diagnosing CTEPH is difficult; algorithms for predicting or ruling out CTEPH are limited by lack of specificity.
diagnostic_notes.registry_characteristics: Median age at diagnosis 63 years; both sexes equally affected; paediatric cases are rare.
diagnostic_notes.symptom_timing: Median time of 14 months between symptom onset and diagnosis in expert centres.
diagnostic_notes.diagnosis_requirement: Diagnosis of CTEPH is based on findings after at least 3 months of effective anticoagulation to distinguish from acute PE.
